# Sona UI

> Source-owned React components with purposeful motion and accessible interaction.

Use the current agent manifest and catalog to select components. Fetch a component's detail resource before installing it; this index is intentionally concise.

When network access is unavailable, treat any installed or downloaded component guidance as a possibly outdated snapshot.

## Get started

- [Installation](https://sonaui.com/docs/installation): Set up the Sona UI registry and install a component.
- [Theming](https://sonaui.com/docs/theming): Adapt components to the consumer project's theme.
- [Use with AI](https://sonaui.com/docs/use-with-ai): Connect an agent and verify component selection.

## Component resources

- [Agent manifest](https://sonaui.com/agent/manifest.json): Current entry point for the catalog and registry skill.
- [Component catalog](https://sonaui.com/agent/catalog.json): Searchable component summaries and links to detailed metadata.
- [Registry index](https://sonaui.com/r/registry.json): Installable registry items.
- [OpenAPI description](https://sonaui.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable API endpoints.

## Optional

- [Component gallery](https://sonaui.com/components): Visual examples of available components.
